solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Inside lorry it's elegantly designed

indicators.note: the shortened 'it is' sits inside the word for the lorry

parts.note: an artic is an articulated lorry
'tis is the poetic contraction of it is, just as it's is

explanation.surface: Someone admires a stylishly designed lorry, or something inside one.
explanation.walkthrough: ARTIC is British slang for an articulated lorry (a semi-trailer truck); 'tis, an old contraction of 'it is', goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done with flair and good taste is described as having an artist's touch, a synonym for elegantly designed.

clue.text: Informed about daughter selling programmes

indicators.note: the word for informed goes about, around, the abbreviation for daughter

parts.note: to be aware is to be informed

explanation.surface: A well-informed person speaks about their daughter's job selling programmes at a theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests theatre programmes; the programmes are computer software.
explanation.definitionFit: This is software that displays advertisements to users, so it is computer code built to sell things.

clue.text: Calculate the full value of babe in arms?

parts.note: a tot is a small child, a babe
a baby in arms is held up off the ground

explanation.surface: Someone asks what a baby in arms is really worth.
explanation.definitionFit: To add up a set of figures to get a total is to calculate their full value.

clue.text: Nervous type, with shrew initially for wife, is more pitiful

indicators.note: one letter is swapped in for the abbreviation for wife

parts.note: a worrier is an anxious, nervous type

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of shrew is used

explanation.surface: A nervous husband who swapped his wife for a shrew is to be pitied all the more.
explanation.walkthrough: WORRIER with its W replaced by S from 'shrew' gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorry can mean wretched or pathetic, as in a sorry sight, so the comparative means more pitiful.

clue.text: I insist a lot, so foolishly — they won't get involved

indicators.note: done foolishly, things go wrong and out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone insists loudly and foolishly, while others refuse to join in.
explanation.definitionFit: These are people, or nations, with a policy of staying out of other countries' affairs, so they won't get involved.

clue.text: Capital right back's minor unsteadiness

indicators.note: 'back' tells us the capital and the abbreviation for right are written backwards

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy

explanation.surface: A right back in some capital city's football team has a slight wobble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right back' looks like a football position, but 'right' gives RT and 'back' reverses ROME + RT.
explanation.definitionFit: A slight shaking or quiver, such as a small earthquake or a trembling hand, is a minor unsteadiness.

clue.text: Sally, I notice, runs to the front

indicators.note: the letter at the end of the notice runs up to the front of the whole piece

parts.note: a poster is a notice put up on a wall

explanation.surface: Sally notices someone running to the front.
explanation.walkthrough: I + POSTER gives IPOSTER; its final R moves to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a witty retort, and a quick sharp reply is a synonym for that.

clue.text: Sort of leave ward and dress

definitions.meaning: time off work for a mother around childbirth is one sort of leave
a hospital ward for mothers giving birth
a loose dress designed for pregnant women

explanation.surface: Someone plans to leave the hospital ward and get dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: Three definitions, each a phrase the answer completes: leave, ward, dress.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes motherhood and pregnancy, and it attaches to all three nouns as a type of each.

clue.text: Friend breaking cartel is driving competition

indicators.note: the friend breaks into the cartel, splitting it open

parts.note: a ring is a group colluding to fix prices, a cartel
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A friend breaking up a cartel is driving competition in the market.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driving competition' reads as economics, but it means a motor rally.
explanation.definitionFit: A rally is a car race over public roads, and taking part in one is a driving competition.

clue.text: Game battle briefly to cross river

indicators.note: the shortened battle name goes across, that is around, the river's name
briefly means the battle's name loses its last letter

parts.note: Waterloo is the 1815 battle where Napoleon was defeated
the Po is Italy's longest river

explanation.surface: A short battle account about an army crossing a river.
explanation.walkthrough: WATERLOO cut short gives WATERLO; the River Po goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a team sport played by swimmers in a pool, passing a ball into goals, so it is a kind of game.

clue.text: A bit of company, not what the lion expects?

definitions.meaning: a single unit of stock in a business, a basic portion of a company
the lion's share is the largest part, so an average share is not what a lion expects

explanation.surface: A lion in a company isn't getting what it expects.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the standard kind of stock in a firm, a small piece of ownership, and it is the opposite of the lion's share.

clue.text: Viola piece with piano not in time when put over

indicators.note: put over, like a thing flipped over, means the combined letters are turned round

parts.note: something not in time is late
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A musician's viola piece, played softly, comes in late when performed.
explanation.walkthrough: The viola here is the flower (a pansy-like plant), not the instrument; the musical words are camouflage.
explanation.definitionFit: A viola is also a garden flower, so one segment of its bloom is a part of that flower.

clue.text: Saint's bone perhaps full of power, a model

indicators.note: the holy object holds the abbreviation for power inside it

parts.note: a saint's bone kept for veneration is an example of a relic
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A saint's bone is credited with power, as a model of holiness.
explanation.definitionFit: A copy made to look exactly like an original, such as a scale reproduction, is a model of it.

clue.text: Break up a day in Rome, not starting with the old ruined city

indicators.note: not starting means the day's name drops its first letter

parts.note: the Ides was a day in the ancient Roman calendar, the 15th of March, for instance
Troy is the ancient city sacked by the Greeks and left in ruins

explanation.surface: A tourist breaks up a day in Rome with a visit to an old ruined city.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ides were fixed days in the Roman month; 'not starting' leaves DES. 'Break up' is the definition, not an instruction to split anything.
explanation.definitionFit: To break up something, in the sense of smashing it to pieces, is to wreck or demolish it.

clue.text: Relief going on manoeuvres in force

indicators.note: troops on manoeuvres move around, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A relief column sets off on army manoeuvres.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvres' rearranges the letters of RELIEF GOING ON; 'in' just joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the French army's famous corps of foreign volunteers, a military force.

clue.text: Inhibit initially fast oxidation speed

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of fast is taken

parts.note: rust is iron oxide, produced by oxidation
rate means speed

explanation.surface: An inhibitor slows down fast oxidation.
explanation.definitionFit: To thwart or prevent someone from achieving something is to inhibit them.

clue.text: Extremely warm temperature damaged coral — good to intervene

indicators.note: the word for good comes between letters of the rearranged coral
damaged means the letters of coral are mixed up

parts.note: pi, short for pious, means good

explanation.surface: Rising temperatures have damaged the coral reefs, and good people should intervene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' gives ROCAL from the reef word; PI (pious) for good is a crossword convention. 'Extremely' belongs to the definition, not a first-and-last signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Weather like that of the tropics, the hot zone near the equator, is extremely warm.

clue.text: Unsophisticated but good worker studied, maintained by your manoeuvring

indicators.note: being maintained by something means being held up within it, so these pieces go inside
manoeuvring means the letters of your are moved around

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in a farmhand
to have read a subject is to have studied it at university

explanation.surface: A good worker who studied hard is kept on by a boss's shrewd manoeuvring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvring' makes ROUY of the last word; 'maintained by' has it hold the other pieces, a hand being a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something crude but serviceable, lacking refinement yet effective, is unsophisticated.

clue.text: Some woman's brief roll in the grass

parts.note: her means belonging to some woman

indicators.note: brief means the bread roll loses its last letter

parts.note: a bagel is a ring-shaped bread roll

explanation.surface: A woman has a quick tumble in the grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roll in the grass' suggests a romp; roll is a bread roll, BAGEL, shortened to BAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: This is grassy vegetation used for grazing, so it means grass collectively.

clue.text: Ancient New Testament language church introduced, not in the morning

indicators.note: the church is introduced into the shortened language
not means the letters for the morning are removed

parts.note: Aramaic was the language spoken by Jesus, used in parts of the New Testament
AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: An ancient language of the New Testament is brought into church, but not for morning service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not in the morning' strips AM to leave ARAIC; 'introduced' then puts the church in. Jesus spoke this language, used in parts of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to a much earlier period, old-fashioned or antiquated, is a synonym for ancient.

clue.text: Servant that's giving birth?

definitions.meaning: a servant who carries things, such as a porter in colonial India
a woman who bears a child is literally the one doing the bearing

explanation.definitionFit: A porter or attendant who carries loads is a servant; one who bears children is giving birth.

clue.text: Police empty a box of theirs, losing one — crackers

indicators.note: empty means only the outside letters of police are kept
losing means the box's name lets go of the letter for one

parts.note: the Tardis in Doctor Who looks like an old blue police box
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Police clear out a box belonging to suspects, minus one item: fireworks.
explanation.walkthrough: The TARDIS is the time machine in the British TV series Doctor Who, shaped like a police telephone box.
explanation.definitionFit: These were small explosive charges, and the word now also covers firecrackers, so they are crackers in the firework sense.

clue.text: Produce from cell in corner of greek island?

parts.note: SE, south-east, names one corner of a map or island
Crete is the largest Greek island

explanation.surface: Something is produced from a cell found in a corner of a Greek island.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a prison cell or a monk's cell; the definition is about a living cell, and the wordplay places it in the south-east of Crete.
explanation.definitionFit: Glands and cells discharge substances such as hormones or saliva; that biological output is what producing from a cell means.

clue.text: No volunteer among the flipping crew

indicators.note: flipping means everything is turned over, read from the end
the soldier goes among the letters of the

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier, classically a draftee rather than a volunteer

explanation.surface: Not one volunteer is found among the wretched crew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild British curse, but it reverses THGIE. US GIs were largely conscripts, hence 'No volunteer'.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing boat is manned by eight oarsmen, so the number names that boat's crew.

clue.text: Cold sea repelled Schumann

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

indicators.note: repelled means the sea's name is driven back, read in reverse

parts.note: the Aral Sea is a shrinking inland sea in Central Asia

explanation.surface: A cold sea drove back the composer Schumann.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites Robert Schumann, but the answer is his wife, the pianist and composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Schumann was the married surname of the celebrated nineteenth-century pianist and composer, Robert's wife, so the surname stands for her.

clue.text: Coach goes round the front, then right, arriving at port

indicators.note: the old coach word wraps round the word for the front

parts.note: a stage, or stagecoach, is a horse-drawn coach
the van is the front, as in vanguard

explanation.surface: A coach drives round the front, turns right, and arrives at a port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes round' makes STAVANGE; 'Coach' is the old stagecoach, not a trainer, and the van of an army is its front.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a Norwegian city on the North Sea coast, a major harbour for the oil industry.

clue.text: Gave a nasty look before coming into the light

indicators.note: coming into means one word is put inside the other

parts.note: an LED is a light-emitting diode, a kind of light
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Someone scowled just before stepping into the light.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone a lecherous or malicious sidelong glance is to give a nasty look.

clue.text: Not entirely happy about animal round projector

indicators.note: the shortened word for happy goes about, around, the animal and the ring
not entirely means the word for happy loses its last letter

parts.note: merry means happy
a cat is an animal
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Someone is less than happy about an animal walking round a projector.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not entirely' leaves MERR, and 'about' wraps it round the rest. 'projector' is a map projection's inventor, not a cinema machine.
explanation.definitionFit: The Flemish cartographer devised a famous map projection, so he is a projector in the map-making sense.
